entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:1
segments: Love to God and to men, a disposition to honor him and do good to them, is the essence of true religion.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:8
segments: The dealings of God in past generations form a cogent reason why all men should obey him.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:9
segments: Floweth with milk and honey; is very fruitful.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:10
segments: Wateredst it with thy foot; drawing up water from the rivers and fountains by treadwheels, with great labor, to keep the land from drying up for want of rain.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:12
segments: Careth for; by granting seasonable rains and rendering it fruitful.
Temporal as well as spiritual blessings are the gift of God, and for them men are indebted to his unmerited favor.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:17
segments: Temporal as well as spiritual judgments are the fruit of sin, and should lead all to hate and forsake it, knowing that if they continue in it, it will prove their ruin.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:18
segments: Lay up these my words in your heart; remember and obey them.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:20
segments: Write them; to make them familiar not only to yourselves, but to your children.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:21
segments:
As the days of heaven upon the earth; that you may continue prosperous and happy to the end of time. 
 
Parents should take measures not only to become acquainted with the commands of God themselves, but to have them deeply impressed on the minds of their children.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:23
segments: Possess greater nations; the countries of those nations.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:24
segments:
The wilderness; of Zin, the south border of Canaan. 
 
  Lebanon; the north border. 
 
  Euphrates; the east border. 
 
  The uttermost sea; the Mediterranean, the west border of Canaan.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:28
segments: Life and death are set before men, and the strongest motives presented to induce them to choose life.  If they do, and show this by taking the way that leads to it, they will live.  If they do not, they will die, and the blame will rest wholly on them.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:29
segments: Put the blessing; cause it to be proclaimed.
Gerizim--Ebal; these are two steep mountains lying near together. Between them was anciently the city Sychem, or Sichem, also called Sychar.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 11:30
segments:
Champaign; "the plain" of the Arabah. 
 
  Gilgal; not the Gilgal where Joshua had his first encampment after crossing the Jordan, but another Gilgal further north, which is named in

. 
 
  The plains of Moreh; or the oaks of Moreh.  See note
